title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode11 Bonded by Music

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-Whaaaaat?!
You're KAITO from another SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're as energetic as ever, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is Tsukasa, the owner of the feelings which created this SEKAI. He's the leader of a troupe called Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It's very nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish we could introduce you to the other two, but they had things to take care of, so they'll be arriving later in the day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, this is Rui.
He's the director for Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, nice to meet the both of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Does your SEKAI by chance have something to do with a school, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because your outfit looks like a school uniform. KAITO and the others from this SEKAI are all wearing outfits which look like costumes for shows because our SEKAI was born out of a strong desire to make people smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Judging from that, it makes sense that your clothing was also influenced by the feelings that made your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh... Y-Yes...
Our SEKAI is a school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Then, does that mean those on your end truly wish to become teachers or something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not teachers, probably...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our SEKAI was born from four people wanting to be together forever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Together forever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. They've been friends since childhood, but drifted apart a little while growing up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They wanted to stay close as they went to school, but couldn't...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And then, that desire to be together grew to the point of giving birth to our SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They wanted to be together but couldn't...
That's very sad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But...
They're okay now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Through their music, their hearts came together... And they've overcome plenty of trials since then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'm sure they'll get to stay together moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounds like they've forged some incredibly strong bonds!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that their wish came true.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Elephant Plushie
rows.Line: Heeeelllp!!
se_event_wl_2nd_piapro_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Elephant Plushie
rows.Line: They're having a big argument down by the harbor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! An argument?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... It sounds like we need to step in, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: G-Go? Where...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Things are better when everybody's smiling♪
So, it's time for Operation Make Up to get underway!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: U-Umm...
Harbor
se_run_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Today's involved so much running for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Everyone, stop!
Things seem a bit chaotic over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That must be where the plushies we were told about are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's go over and get them to make up!
se_run_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are things really going to be okay...?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line:
But you just got to play the hero!
It's my turn next!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
No, I'm gonna play the hero!
You're not good enough for it!

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: Why not?! Also, saying things like that means you're not good enough either!

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: I'm done doing shows with you!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Fine! I'm never talking to you again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like this argument began over a casting issue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand why someone would want to play a certain role...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they said that they're never gonna talk to each other ever again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'd be terrible if they actually stopped doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what can we do...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's obvious!
This situation calls for one thing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ready?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? One thing...?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Hmph! I'm never forgiving you for this!

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: Right back at you!

“Why?!
Why is everyone calling him the hero and not me?!”

rows.Speaker: Hero A
rows.Line: “Okay, all those nasty bugs are gone from this field.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Thanks, Mr. Hero!
Now I'll be able to harvest lots of veggies!”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “I... I brought peace back to this world after defeating that evil secret society! And yet—!”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line:
“Time has made everyone forget that fact.
And now, airheaded interlopers such as him are being lauded as heroes! Why is that?!”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “I am the true hero...!”
“Honestly, when did you get this way?”
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “You're... The professor?!”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line:
“Long time no see, hero.
Or rather, former hero, no?”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line: “Back then... You weren't like this when you were desperately trying to return peace to the world. You never obsessed over titles and fame.”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “What?! My feelings have not changed since then. I want the world to remain a peaceful place...!”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line:
“Yes, but we're all heroes in that sense...
Including the ones you claim aren't fit for the title.”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line:
“We all want the world to remain peaceful.
We all feel the same way as you.”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “The same way...?”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line: “Just take a look. Those fishing by the harbor, the proprietors providing food for others and the ones providing transportation to everyone... They make the world go round.”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line: “You may not realize it yet, but this world is filled with heroes.”

rows.Speaker: Professor
rows.Line: “If you can't see that, then I'm not sure that you can continue being one.”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “I had no idea...”

rows.Speaker: Former Legendary Hero
rows.Line: “I... I was so convinced that I was the truest of all heroes...”

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: I... I just kept thinking about myself...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The plushies have stopped arguing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're rethinking things after seeing that show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But will it get them to make up?

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: We made a terrible mistake, didn't we...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow. Their minds were changed so quickly...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I thought getting them to stop arguing would be so difficult... But look how they did it.)

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line:
I'm sorry. Let's make up...
What if we both play the hero this time?
se_event_wl_2nd_piapro_2025_001

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, he ran towards the city!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's split up and try to find him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought he went this way...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Wh-Who are you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I saw you arguing earlier...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... Do you not want to keep doing shows with that other plushie?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: What's it matter to you?! I don't care if I ever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It would be hard to listen to the words of an outsider such as myself...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But something tells me that he's just trying to act tough.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I want to help him, but I don't know what to say...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is a tricky one.
He's feeling defensive, and he isn't being honest with how he truly feels.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be able to help him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, you know how to put on performances which move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I can't stop them from arguing by putting on a show like Tsukasa and the others.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(This feeling...
I can empathize with him through sound.)

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: What a gentle sound...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I'm starting to remember all the times I hung out with him. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I wonder if...we're really never ever gonna do another show together.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I want to hang out with him again... So I should see if we can make up.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I'm gonna go find him!
se_event_wl_2nd_piapro_2025_001

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness...
Nicely done, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Were you all watching just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're sorry. We know we should've said something, but your performance was just so beautiful that we had to sit and listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're such an amazing guitarist, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Your sound is so gentle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, how do I put it...
It's as though you were able to express exactly how you felt through sound alone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And it was a very nice sound.
You were able to show real empathy without saying a word to him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. For our next show, why don't we try to captivate everyone like KAITO just did, but with song and dance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There may even be things we can only do with such a format!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow!
I wanna give that a try☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That does sound fun.
Why don't we start working on it now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It looks like I didn't need to worry about “me” at all.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Not only was he able to help the plushies, he was even able to influence Tsukasa and the others.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm sure that will help with his self-confidence in the future.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad for you.

rows.Speaker: Movie
